# Apex Demolition & Excavation

> Locally owned demolition and excavation company serving West Milton, Ohio and the
> greater Dayton / Miami Valley area. Residential and commercial demolition,
> excavation, land clearing & sitework, and hauling & material delivery.

Phone: (937) 694-3182
Email: Samuelh@apex-excavationllc.com
Address: 50 Jessicas Place, West Milton, OH 45383
Hours: Monday - Friday, 7am - 5pm

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.apexdemolitionexcavation.com/): Overview of Apex's services, process, and recent work.
- [Services](https://www.apexdemolitionexcavation.com/services): Full list of services offered.
- [Demolition](https://www.apexdemolitionexcavation.com/services/demolition): Residential and commercial demolition, concrete removal, debris haul-off.
- [Excavation](https://www.apexdemolitionexcavation.com/services/excavation): Foundation, utility, and drainage excavation.
- [Land Clearing & Sitework](https://www.apexdemolitionexcavation.com/services/land-clearing-sitework): Brush clearing, grading, and site preparation.
- [Hauling & Material Delivery](https://www.apexdemolitionexcavation.com/services/hauling-material-delivery): Topsoil, gravel, mulch delivery and debris hauling.
